    metadata['final_owner_execution']={'passed':167,'failed':0,'ignored':4,'filtered_out':0,'explicitly_ignored_ids':ignored_ids,'boundary':'Default owner library execution; retained-source and host-measurement tests remain intentionally unexecuted.     integration=next(c for c in metadata['commands'] if c['label']=='ai_final_integration_ids')['argv'][0]

    assert stale==before_stale,(stale,before_stale)
    metadata['final_selected_harness_guard']={'violations':violations,'other_stale_entries_outside_selected_harness_scope':stale,'boundary':'Only owner+AI integration compiled evidence; this is not the full-workspace duplicate-source gate'}
    save()
    run('ai_duplicate_guard_regressions',['python3','tools/repository/test_check_duplicate_test_sources.py','-v'])
    run('ai_owner_clippy',['cargo','+1.100.0','clippy','--locked','-p','oteryn-gameplay-monster-ai','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings'])
    run('ai_owner_non_test_build',['cargo','+1.100.0','build','--locked','-p','oteryn-gameplay-monster-ai','--lib'])
    run('server_all_targets_clippy',['cargo','+1.100.0','clippy','--locked','-p','oteryn-game-server','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings'])
    run('server_default_build',['cargo','+1.100.0','build','--locked','-p','oteryn-game-server'])
    run('ai_owner_package_fmt',['cargo','+1.100.0','fmt','--package','oteryn-gameplay-monster-ai','--','--check'])
    run('server_package_fmt',['cargo','+1.100.0','fmt','--package','oteryn-game-server','--','--check'])
    assert metadata['candidate_sha256']=={p:hashlib.sha256((repo/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}
    metadata['unrun_gates']=['full workspace duplicate-source guard','four explicitly ignored owner source/host-measurement cases']
    metadata['status']='PASS';save()

    metadata['status']='FAIL_CONTINUATION';metadata['error']=str(error);save();raise
